justification: Data insertion script for gap-fill controls across 6 top-volume councils (13 rows). No schema changes, no frontend changes. Uses established insert pattern with dedup check. NULL value_min rows for councils that defer to standards or use LEP FSR — literal DCP citations stored.

pre_impl.existing_data: dcp_setback_controls table — checked existing rows for each (lga, control_type, dev_type) combo. All 13 are new gaps.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: value_max vs value_min column selection: rows with max_site_coverage use value_max, others use value_min. Script handles via val_col logic at line 338.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: All 13 rows are new. Dedup check prevents duplicates on re-run.

functions.name: main
functions.output: INSERT 13 rows into dcp_setback_controls with various control_types, committed on success
functions.if_none: If DATABASE_URL is None, psycopg2.connect raises OperationalError

values.nullable: yes — NULL for 4 rows (deep_soil_min defer-to-landscaping, max_site_coverage FSR-controlled)
values.guard_at: DB columns allow NULL. condition + source_text contain human-readable DCP position.
values.if_missing: Row stored with NULL value, condition/source_text explains DCP position

values.nullable: no — NOT NULL constraint in DB

queries.purpose: Dedup check — skip rows that already exist
queries.where_clause: lga = %s AND control_type = %s AND dev_type = %s AND condition LIKE %s AND is_current = TRUE
queries.if_zero: Row is new — proceed with INSERT
queries.if_wrong: False positive on condition prefix could skip legitimate row — mitigated by 30-char prefix being unique per row
Wrong value or source_text would serve incorrect data — mitigated by verified DCP citations

break_it.scenario: val_col logic picks wrong column (value_min vs value_max) for a row
break_it.what_happens: Row stored in wrong column — e.g. max_site_coverage 60% stored in value_min instead of value_max
break_it.how: Lines 337-338: rows with value_max key get val_col='value_max', rows with value_min key get val_col='value_min'. Each GAP_ROWS dict uses exactly one of the two keys.

break_it.scenario: Dedup check fails (DB timeout) causing duplicate rows on re-run
break_it.what_happens: User sees double controls for same council/type
break_it.how: Line 319: dedup SELECT on (lga, control_type, dev_type, condition LIKE prefix, is_current). If SELECT fails, exception at line 380, conn.rollback() prevents partial insert.

break_it.scenario: Camden rear_setback 4m (single storey) applied to two-storey building
break_it.what_happens: User sees wrong setback for their building type
break_it.how: Two separate rows with distinct condition text: 'Single storey: 4m' vs 'Two storey (two-storey component): 6m'. Frontend shows condition text.

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes — spot-check: SELECT lga, control_type, value_min, value_max, condition FROM dcp_setback_controls WHERE lga IN ('blacktown','the_hills','camden','randwick') AND control_type IN ('max_site_coverage','rear_setback','landscaping_min','deep_soil_min','car_parking') AND is_current = TRUE ORDER BY lga, control_type;
